import subprocess
# Use pdftotext to find form feed characters (page breaks)
result = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', '-layout', 'main.pdf', '-'], capture_output=True, text=True)
pages = result.stdout.split('\f')
print(f'Total pages: {len(pages)}')
for i, page in enumerate(pages):
    # Show first meaningful line of each page
    lines = [l.strip() for l in page.split('\n') if l.strip()]
    first = lines[0][:100] if lines else '(empty)'
    last = lines[-1][:100] if lines else '(empty)'
    print(f'Page {i+1}: starts={first}')
    # Check if this page has References or Limitations
    text = page.lower()
    if 'limitations' in text and i >= 6:
        print(f'  >> Contains \"Limitations\"')
    if 'references' in text and any(l.strip().lower().startswith('references') for l in page.split('\n')):
        print(f'  >> Contains \"References\" header')
"
